instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. Inside a judo dojo with yellow tatami mats, the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) stands leaning forward, pinning the young man in the white judo gi (R2) to the floor. The young man (R2) lies on his back, looking up, while the woman (R1) grips his collar to maintain control. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the warm tones of the yellow mat.
